channel.title: GiveOwl – Black Friday sweepstakes & giveaways 2026
channel.description: 17 Black Friday sweepstakes and giveaways are open for 2026, 6 explicitly marked confirmed, all marked free to enter; the first closes on November 11, 2026 (Guitar Center) and the last on December 31, 2026 (Valentine Brands LLC d/b/a Seranova Beauty).

item.title: Guitar Center Fender Pre-Black Friday Sweepstakes – Guitar Center
item.description: Prize: Fender prize package: American Ultra II Stratocaster, '65 Twin Reverb amp, Jackson American Series Virtuoso, EVH 5150III amp, pedalboard, power supply, pedals and cables (ARV $10,004.71). Deadline: November 11, 2026. Fill in the entry form at guitarcenter.com/gear-giveaway.gc (or scan the QR code in participating stores). One entry per person/email. No purchase necessary; legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, 18+. Oct 29 – Nov 11, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

item.title: KILLSTAR Black Friday Gift Card Giveaway: win a $1,000 gift card – KILLSTAR (Draco Distribution Ltd)
item.description: Prize: One $1,000 KILLSTAR gift card for one US winner (valid 6 months). Deadline: November 22, 2026. No purchase necessary: submit your email via an official KILLSTAR sign-up form and confirm the subscription in the confirmation email. Optional SMS opt-in gives one bonus entry (max 2 entries). Legal residents of the 50 US states and DC, 18+. Ends 11:59 pm ET on November 22, 2026

item.title: MTN OPS x Hoyt Black Friday Early Access Giveaway: two 2027 Hoyt bows – MTN OPS
item.description: Prize: 2 winners: one HOYT 2027 Carbon Bow (ARV $2,149) and one HOYT 2027 Aluminum Bow (ARV $1,449); total ARV $3,598. Deadline: November 22, 2026. Sign up for MTN OPS Black Friday Early Access (email/phone) on the giveaway page; signing up is your entry. No purchase necessary. US residents 18+, excluding FL, NY and RI. Nov 2 – Nov 22, 2026

item.title: 4D Gaming Early Black Friday Sweepstakes: gaming session with Wildcat & Blarg + PS5 GTA VI bundle – 4D Gaming LLC
item.description: Prize: Grand prize: gaming session with Wildcat & Blarg (ARV $2,500); PS5 + GTA VI bundle ($729.98); 8 mousepad bundles. Deadline: November 23, 2026. Free mail-in entry (counts as 100 entries): handwrite your full legal name, residential address and email and mail it to 4D Gaming Early Black Friday Sweepstakes, 1100 3rd Ave N, #265, Nashville, TN 37208 (postmarked by Nov 23, received by Nov 25). Purchases also earn entries. 50 US + DC, 18+. Oct 23 – Nov 23, 2026 (CT)

item.title: The Forward Bar BFCM Sweepstakes – The Forward Company, Inc.
item.description: Prize: Up to a three-year supply of The Forward Bar protein bars (3 winners: 36, 12 and 6 boxes; total ARV $2,159). Deadline: November 24, 2026. Sign up with your email on The Forward Bar VIP list page; free bonus entry requests on the same page (up to 5). Signing up in Wave 1 (by Nov 1) gives the most entries. 18+, 50 states + DC. Ends Nov 24, 2026

Free entry: email contact@electrogum.com with subject "Apple Watch Giveaway Entry", your full name, email and state (a subscription order also gives one entry). 18+, 50 US + DC except Rhode Island. One entry per person

Enter via the online form with name and email or mobile; no purchase and no marketing opt-in required. Legal residents of the 50 US + DC, 18+. Nov 1, 16:00 GMT to Nov 29, 2026 23:59 GMT

Five weekly periods Oct 28 – Nov 29, 2026, 11:59:59 PM PT
